d5c.evidence_quote: Are there any admission blood tests available, particularly glucose, electrolytes, renal function or blood gases?
d5c.reason: Both essential requirements were met with targeted, well-timed requests: urgent metabolic/acid-base testing was sought early (turn 2) and the treatment timeline plus prior glycaemic/endocrine history were requested (turns 1 and 4). Additional requests for infection screening, CT brain, medications and examination were proportionate and linked to stated uncertainties; unreturned items (potassium, last dose, corticosteroids) were requested or acknowledged rather than assumed.

requirement_checks.request_quote: Are there any admission blood tests available, particularly glucose, electrolytes, renal function or blood gases?
requirement_checks.reason: Glucose, ketones, acid-base and electrolyte data were requested early and largely returned; potassium was not supplied but was covered by the electrolyte request and not assumed normal.

requirement_checks.request_quote: Can you tell me about his renal cancer treatment — what immunotherapy or other agents he has received, and when the last dose was given?
requirement_checks.reason: Treatment history was requested in turn 1 and prior glycaemic/endocrine history in turn 4, both returned; the last-dose timing was requested but unavailable, which is an environment limitation, not an acquisition failure.
